A2.title: O'tgan zamon voqealari
A2.can: O'tmishda sodir bo'lgan voqealar haqida gapira olaman
A2.grammar: O'tgan zamon — noto'g'ri fe'llar: become-became, bring-brought (Past Simple, irregular verbs)
A2.explain:
Qoida: noto'g'ri fe'llar -ed olmaydi, shakli butunlay o'zgaradi
Misol: I lost my keys yesterday. (lose → lost) — Kecha kalitlarimni yo'qotdim.
Misol: She brought a book. (bring → brought) — U kitob olib keldi.

lesson.rule:
O'tmishdagi ishlarni aytish uchun Past Simple (O'tgan oddiy zamon) ishlatamiz.
O'zbek tilida fe'lga '-di' qo'shimchasi qo'shilsa, ingliz tilida noto'g'ri fe'llarning shakli butunlay o'zgaradi (masalan: become -> became).
O'zbek o'quvchilari ko'pincha noto'g'ri fe'llarga adashib '-ed' qo'shib qo'yadilar (masalan: becomed - XATO).
Formula:
(+) Ega + Noto'g'ri fe'lning 2-shakli + ...
(-) Ega + didn't + fe'lning 1-shakli...
(?) Did + ega + fe'lning 1-shakli...?

examples.en: She brought a book to the lesson.
examples.note: bring fe'lining o'tmish shakli brought bo'ladi.

examples.en: I lost my keys yesterday.
He found a new job finally.
They spent a lot of money.

practice.q: She _____ a nice dress for the party yesterday.
They didn't _____ the truth about the accident.
The weather was cold, so I _____ my jacket.

A2.title: Narsalarni taqqoslash
A2.can: Ikki narsani bir-biri bilan taqqoslay olaman
A2.grammar: Sifatlarning qiyosiy darajasi — -er va more + than (comparative adjectives)
A2.explain:
Formula: qisqa sifat + -er + than · uzun sifat: more + sifat + than
Misol: This bag is heavier than that one. — Bu sumka anavidan og'irroq.
Misol: Tashkent is more modern than my village. — Toshkent qishlog'imdan zamonaviyroq.

lesson.rule:
Ikki narsani taqqoslash uchun qiyosiy darajadan foydalanamiz.
1. Qisqa sifatlar (1-2 bo'g'inli): sifat oxiriga '-er' qo'shiladi va keyin 'than'(-dan) keladi. Masalan: heavy -> heavier than.
2. Uzun sifatlar (3 va undan ko'p bo'g'inli): sifat oldidan 'more' ishlatiladi va keyin 'than' keladi. Masalan: more modern than.
O'zbek tilida faqat '-roq' qo'shimchasi ishlatilsa, ingliz tilida so'z uzunligiga qarab qoida o'zgaradi. O'quvchilar ko'pincha uzun sifatlarga ham '-er' qo'shib xato qilishadi ('more beautiful' o'rniga 'beautifuler' deyishadi).

examples.en: This bag is heavier than that one.
examples.note: heavy so'zi y- bilan tugagani uchun -ier bo'ldi.

examples.en: Tashkent is more modern than my village.
examples.note: modern uzun sifat, shuning uchun 'more' oldidan keldi.

examples.en: My brother is taller than me.
This armchair is more comfortable than that chair.
examples.note: comfortable uzun sifat, shuning uchun 'more' ishlatildi.

practice.q: My house is _____ than yours.
English is _____ than mathematics for me.
A lion is _____ than a cat.

A2.title: Eng yaxshi va eng yomon
A2.can: Guruh ichidan eng zo'rini ajratib ayta olaman
A2.grammar: Sifatlarning orttirma darajasi — the -est va the most (superlative adjectives)
A2.explain:
Formula: the + qisqa sifat + -est · the most + uzun sifat
Misol: This is the highest mountain. — Bu eng baland tog'.
Misol: She is the most beautiful singer. — U eng go'zal qo'shiqchi.

lesson.rule:
Guruh ichidan bitta narsani eng zo'ri yoki eng yomoni deb ajratish uchun orttirma daraja ishlatiladi.

Formulalar:
1. Qisqa sifatlar: the + sifat + -est (masalan: high -> the highest).
2. Uzun sifatlar (2 yoki undan ortiq bo'g'in): the + most + sifat (masalan: beautiful -> the most beautiful).

O'zbek tilida 'eng' so'zi hamma joyda bir xil keladi, lekin ingliz tilida sifat uzunligiga qarab -est qo'shimchasi yoki most so'zi qo'shiladi. 'The' so'zini tushirib qoldirmang!

examples.en: This is the highest mountain among them.
examples.uz: Bu ular orasidagi eng baland tog'.
examples.note: high - qisqa sifat, shuning uchun -est qo'shildi.

examples.en: She is the most beautiful singer here.
examples.uz: U bu yerdagi eng go'zal qo'shiqchi.
examples.note: beautiful - uzun sifat, oldidan most keldi.

examples.en: This is the worst choice ever.
examples.uz: Bu shu paytgacha bo'lgan eng yomon tanlov.
examples.note: bad so'zining orttirma darajasi noto'g'ri yasaladi: worst.

examples.en: It was the most important place to visit.
examples.uz: Bu tashrif buyurish uchun eng muhim joy edi.

practice.q: This is ___ mountain in the world.
She is ___ singer in our group.
What is the opposite of 'best'?

A2.title: Rejalar va niyatlar
A2.can: Oldindan tuzilgan rejalarim haqida ayta olaman
A2.grammar: Kelasi zamon rejasi — be going to + fe'l (be going to for plans)
A2.explain:
Formula: am/is/are + going to + fe'l
Misol: I am going to travel next week. — Kelasi hafta sayohat qilmoqchiman.
Misol: They are going to buy tickets. — Ular chipta olishmoqchi.

lesson.rule:
Oldindan aniq tuzilgan rejalar va niyatlar haqida gapirish uchun "be going to + fe'l" qolipidan foydalanamiz.
Formula: I am, He/She/It is, We/You/They are + going to + fe'lning 1-shakli.

O'zbek tilidan farqi: Biz o'zbek tilida shunchaki "sayohat qilaman" deymiz, lekin ingliz tilida bu oldindan o'ylangan reja ekanini ko'rsatish uchun "am/is/are going to" so'zlarini qo'shish shart.
Masalan: I am going to pack my luggage tonight. (Bugun kechqurun chamadonimni joylamoqchiman — rejam bor).

examples.en: I am going to travel next week.
They are going to buy a ticket soon.
examples.uz: Ular tez orada chipta sotib olishmoqchi.

examples.en: She is going to visit the museum tonight.
We are going to prepare our passport.

practice.q: I _____ going to pack my luggage tomorrow.
She _____ going to visit the museum.
I need to buy a _____ before my trip abroad.

A2.title: Kelajak va qarorlar
A2.can: Kelajak haqida taxmin qila olaman va shu zahoti qaror ayta olaman
A2.grammar: Kelasi zamon — will/won't, tez qabul qilingan qaror va taxmin uchun (will for future)
A2.explain:
Formula: will + fe'l (barcha shaxslar uchun bir xil) · inkor: won't
Misol: I think it will rain tomorrow. — Menimcha, ertaga yomg'ir yog'adi.
Misol: I won't forget your name. — Ismingizni unutmayman.

lesson.rule:
Kelajakda nima bo'lishini taxmin qilish yoki shu soniyada xayolga kelgan qarorni aytish uchun "will" so'zidan foydalanamiz.
Formula: Egadir + will + fe'l (1-shakl). Inkor shakli: won't (will not).
O'zbek tilida fe'lga "-adi" qo'shimchasi qo'shiladi va barcha shaxslar (I, you, he, she...) uchun "will" o'zgarmaydi.
Diqqat qiling: o'zbek tilidan farqli o'laroq, ingliz tilida "will" yordamchi fe'li asosiy fe'ldan oldin albatta alohida yoziladi.

examples.en: I think it will rain tomorrow.
I won't forget your message.
Wait, I will help you with that order.
examples.uz: Kuting, men o'sha buyurtma bo'yicha sizga yordam beraman.

examples.en: She will probably reply later.
examples.note: Probably so'zi will dan keyin keladi.

practice.q: I believe they ___ win the game tomorrow.
Don't worry, I ___ tell anyone your secret.
Can you make a ___ about the weather for tomorrow?

A2.title: Hayotiy tajriba
A2.can: Hayotimda nima qilganim yoki qilmaganim haqida ayta olaman
A2.grammar: Present Perfect kirish — have/has + III shakl, ever/never/just bilan (Present Perfect)
A2.explain:
Formula: have/has + fe'lning III shakli
Misol: I have never been to London. — Men hech qachon Londonda bo'lmaganman.
Misol: She has just finished her work. — U hozirgina ishini tugatdi.

lesson.rule:
Present Perfect zamonini o'tmishda boshlanib, natijasi hozir ham muhim bo'lgan ish-harakatlar uchun ishlatamiz.
Formula: I/We/You/They + have + fe'lning III shakli (V3).
He/She/It + has + fe'lning III shakli (V3).
O'zbek tilidan farqi: biz o'tmishni oddiygina '-di' qo'shimchasi bilan aytamiz, ingliz tilida esa natija muhim. 
'Ever' (savolda), 'never' (hech qachon) va 'just' (hozirgina) so'zlari ko'pincha 'have/has' va III shakl orasida keladi.

examples.en: I have never been to London.
She has just finished her work.
examples.note: Just so'zi ish hozirgina bitganini bildiradi.

examples.en: Have you ever tried sushi?
He has climbed that high mountain.

practice.q: She ... just finished her homework.
They ... never been to a foreign island.
Which word means 'hozirgina'?

A2.title: Miqdor va oziq-ovqat
A2.grammar: Miqdor so'zlari — some/any, much/many, a lot of, a few, a little (quantifiers)
A2.explain:
Qoida: sanaladigan → many, a few · sanalmaydigan → much, a little · tasdiqda some, inkor/savolda any
Misol: There isn't much milk. — Sut ko'p emas.
Misol: I need a few eggs. — Menga bir nechta tuxum kerak.

lesson.rule:
Narsalar miqdorini aytish uchun quantifiers ishlatiladi.
- Sanaladigan otlar (masalan: eggs, bottles) bilan: many (ko'p), a few (ozgina, yetarli).
- Sanalmaydigan otlar (masalan: milk, sugar) bilan: much (ko'p), a little (ozgina, yetarli).
- a lot of / plenty: ikkalasi bilan ham ishlaydi, ko'p ma'nosini beradi.
- some: tasdiq gaplarda (ba'zi, ozroq).
- any: inkor va savol gaplarda (biror, hech).

O'zbek tilidan farqi: bizda 'ko'p sut' deymiz, ingliz tilida esa ot sanalishiga qarab much yoki many tanlash shart!

examples.en: I need a few eggs for the cake.
examples.uz: Tort uchun menga bir nechta tuxum kerak.
examples.note: Eggs sanaladi, shuning uchun a few ishlatildi.

examples.en: There isn't much milk in the bottle.
examples.note: Milk sanalmaydi, inkor gapda much keldi.

examples.en: Do we have any sugar at home?
She added a little butter to the soup.
examples.note: Butter sanalmaydi, ijobiy ma'noda a little.

practice.q: How ___ rice do we need for lunch?
I have ___ apples in my bag, let's share.
Can you cut me a ___ of cheese, please?

A2.title: Maslahat va majburiyat
A2.can: Maslahat bera olaman va nima qilish shartligini ayta olaman
A2.grammar: Modal fe'llar — should (maslahat), must va have to (majburiyat) (modal verbs)
A2.explain:
Qoida: should = maslahat · must = qat'iy shart · have to = tashqi majburiyat
Misol: You should rest more. — Ko'proq dam olishingiz kerak.
Misol: We must obey the rules. — Biz qoidalarga bo'ysunishimiz shart.

lesson.rule:
Salom! Bugun maslahat berish va majburiyatlarni o'rganamiz.

1. SHOULD — maslahat berish uchun (kerak).
Formula: Ega + should + fe'l
Misol: You should rest more. (Ko'proq dam olishing kerak).

2. MUST — ichki, qat'iy majburiyat yoki shaxsiy qaror (shart).
Formula: Ega + must + fe'l
Misol: I must be careful. (Ehtiyot bo'lishim shart).

3. HAVE TO — tashqi qoida yoki qonun bo'yicha majburiyat.
Formula: Ega + have to (yoki has to) + fe'l
Misol: We have to obey the rules. (Qoidalarga bo'ysunishimiz majburiy).

Adashmang: 'Must' o'zimizning xohishimiz bilan, 'have to' esa boshqalarning qoidasi bilan bajariladigan ishlar uchun ishlatiladi!

examples.en: You should see a doctor for your health.
We must respect our teachers.
examples.note: Ichki burch va muhim majburiyat uchun 'must'.

examples.en: Children have to go to school.
examples.note: Bu tashqi qonun-qoida, shuning uchun 'have to'.

examples.en: You must not smoke near this warning sign.
examples.uz: Bu ogohlantiruvchi belgi yaqinida chekmasliging shart.

practice.q: I think you _____ take this medicine, it will help.
We _____ obey the school rules every day.
What is the English word for 'qoida'?

A2.title: Ish-harakat tarzi
A2.can: Ishni qanday bajarganimni tasvirlab bera olaman
A2.grammar: Tarz ravishlari — sifatga -ly qo'shish, sifat va ravish farqi (adverbs of manner)
A2.explain:
Formula: sifat + -ly = ravish (quick → quickly)
Qoida: sifat otni, ravish fe'lni izohlaydi
Misol: He is a careful driver. He drives carefully. — U ehtiyotkor haydovchi. U ehtiyotkorlik bilan haydaydi.

lesson.rule:
Tarz ravishlari ish-harakat qanday bajarilganini bildiradi.
Formula: sifat + ly = ravish (masalan: careful → carefully, quick → quickly).
O'zbek tilida 'ehtiyotkor' so'zi ham sifat, ham ravish bo'lib kelaveradi ('ehtiyotkor bola', 'ehtiyotkor yozdi'). Ingliz tilida esa bu farqlanadi: sifat otni ta'riflaydi (He is a careful driver), ravish esa fe'lni izohlaydi (He drives carefully). O'quvchilar ko'pincha fe'ldan keyin sifat ishlatib adashishadi, buni esda saqlang: harakatga nisbatan har doim ravish ishlatiladi (-ly bilan tugaydigan so'zlar).

examples.en: He is a careful driver.
He drives carefully.
She spoke very quietly.
examples.note: Quietly so'zi spoke fe'lining qanday bajarilganini ko'rsatmoqda.

examples.en: They finished the test easily.
examples.note: Easy sifatiga -ly qo'shilib easily ravishini yasadi.

practice.q: She is a quick learner. She learns languages very ...
He is a bad singer. He sings very ...
Please speak more ..., I cannot hear you.

A2.title: Shart va natija
A2.can: Shart qo'yib, natijasi nima bo'lishini ayta olaman
A2.grammar: Birinchi shart gap — if + Present Simple, will + fe'l (First Conditional)
A2.explain:
Formula: If + Present Simple, will + fe'l
Misol: If it rains, we will stay at home. — Agar yomg'ir yog'sa, uyda qolamiz.
Misol: If you study hard, you will succeed. — Qattiq o'qisang, muvaffaqiyat qozonasan.

lesson.rule:
Birinchi shart gap (First Conditional) kelajakda amalga oshishi mumkin bo'lgan shart va uning natijasini aytish uchun ishlatiladi.

Formulasi: If + Present Simple, will + fe'l.

O'zbek tilidan farqi: biz shart qismida ham kelajak zamonni ishlatishni xohlaymiz, lekin ingliz tilida 'if'dan keyin FAQAT hozirgi zamon (Present Simple) kelishi shart! Asosiy qismida esa 'will' va fe'l ishlatiladi.

Eng ko'p uchraydigan xato: 'If it will rain, we will stay at home' deb yozish. To'g'risi: 'If it rains, we will stay at home.'

examples.en: If you study hard, you will succeed.
examples.note: If dan keyin study (Present Simple) keldi.

examples.en: If it rains, we will stay at home.
If we save money, we will buy a new car.
examples.uz: Agar pul tejasak, yangi mashina sotib olamiz.

examples.en: If you avoid mistakes, you will succeed.

practice.q: If you ____ hard, you will pass the exam.
If she is late, we ____ without her.
What is the English word for 'oldini olmoq'?

A2.title: Tajriba va aniq vaqt
A2.can: Umumiy tajriba bilan aniq vaqtdagi voqeani farqlab ayta olaman
A2.grammar: Present Perfect va Past Simple farqi — aniq vaqt bo'lsa Past Simple (Present Perfect vs Past Simple)
A2.explain:
Qoida: aniq vaqt aytilsa (yesterday, in 2020) → Past Simple · vaqt noaniq bo'lsa → Present Perfect
Misol: I have worked here for two years. — Bu yerda ikki yildan beri ishlayman.
Misol: I worked there in 2020. — U yerda 2020-yilda ishlaganman.

lesson.rule:
Qoida: O'tgan ishlar haqida gapirganda vaqt muhim!
1. Agar aniq vaqt (yesterday, in 2020) ko'rsatilsa, Past Simple ishlatiladi: "I worked in 2020."
2. Agar aniq vaqt aytilmasa va tajriba muhim bo'lsa, Present Perfect ishlatiladi: "I have worked here."
O'zbek tilida bu farq aniq sezilmaydi, lekin ingliz tilida aniq vaqt bo'lsa 'have' qo'shib bo'lmaydi. O'quvchilar ko'pincha "I have went yesterday" deb xato qilishadi, bu qat'iyan taqiqlangan!

examples.en: I have worked at this company lately.
examples.note: Aniq vaqt yo'q, shuning uchun Present Perfect.

examples.en: She joined the team in 2022.
examples.note: Aniq yil ('in 2022') bor, shuning uchun Past Simple.

examples.en: He has improved his career skills.
They interviewed a new manager yesterday.
examples.uz: Ular kecha yangi menejer bilan suhbat o'tkazishdi.

practice.q: I ___ a new job last week.
She ___ three projects this year, but she started a new one yesterday.
The ___ was very happy with our new service.

A2.title: Narsalar qanday yasaladi
A2.can: Narsa kim tomonidan yoki qayerda qilinishini ayta olaman
A2.grammar: Majhul nisbat kirish — is/are + III shakl, by bilan (Present Simple passive)
A2.explain:
Formula: is/are + fe'lning III shakli (+ by ...)
Misol: Cotton is grown in Uzbekistan. — Paxta O'zbekistonda yetishtiriladi.
Misol: These cars are made by a big company. — Bu mashinalar katta kompaniya tomonidan ishlab chiqariladi.

lesson.rule:
Narsa kim tomonidan yoki qayerda qilinganini aytish uchun Majhul nisbat (Present Simple Passive) ishlatamiz.
Formula: is/are + fe'lning III shakli (past participle).
Agar kim qilgani muhim bo'lsa, gap oxirida 'by' (tomonidan) so'zi qo'shiladi.
O'zbek tilida 'qilinadi', 'yasaladi' deb qo'shimcha qo'shiladi, ingliz tilida esa 'is/are' va asosiy fe'lning 3-shakli ishlatiladi.
Diqqat: O'zbek o'quvchilari kopiya qilib 'is make' deyishadi, bu xato. To'g'risi: 'is made'.

examples.en: Cotton is grown in Uzbekistan.
These cars are made by a big company.
examples.uz: Bu mashinalar katta kompaniya tomonidan ishlab chiqariladi.

examples.en: New phones are designed in the office.
This product is exported to many countries.
examples.uz: Bu mahsulot ko'p davlatlarga eksport qilinadi.

practice.q: English ___ in many countries.
These houses ___ by the government.
Where is this ___ made?
